note: Review budgets per cycle, in USD. A cycle is a calendar month in UTC, starting on cycle_anchor_day (the 1st), the day the Console resets the pr-review workspace's monthly cap. console_cap_usd is that cap, and global_usd never passes it, so the gate pauses before the Console stops a review (tests/test_budgets.py). The count is never below what was spent: each call is charged its reported cost, or its whole budget when it has no result, fails or is cancelled, and a run that never settles keeps its cap. Overrides are keyed by numeric GitHub user id, never by name. What anyone has spent lives only in the private ledger.
